how_to_apply: IRCTC SCZ Apply process is through walk-in interview; there is no online application portal for these posts.
Download and fill the Proforma/Application Form attached with the relevant notification (Hospitality Monitors or Tourism Monitors) on www.irctc.com.

Complete all fields: personal details, category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS/Ex.SM), present and permanent address, contact details, date of birth and age (as on 01.09.2026), gender, marital status, Aadhaar number, educational qualification details (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post Graduation), post-qualification experience, and languages known.

Attach self-attested copies of proof of educational qualification (certificates and marksheets), proof of experience (if any), proof of date of birth (10th certificate), and proof of category (OBC-NCL candidates must submit the certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India).
Affix a recent photograph and sign the declaration confirming that the information provided is true and correct.

Carry the completed application form, along with original documents, one set of attested copies, and two recent passport-size photographs, to the applicable walk-in interview venue on the scheduled date and time.
Tourism Monitors candidates should note that they can appear for interview at only one of the two convenient venues.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC SCZ Scope of Work 2026
content_sections.text: Responsible for the supervision and monitoring of food production, quality & services in nominated mobile catering units (Vande Bharat Trains/Mail/Express trains/TSVs)/Tourist Trains/Bharat Gaurav Trains, etc. Responsible for the supervision and monitoring of food production and quality in nominated static catering units/Base Kitchens/Cluster Kitchens, as well as kitchens supplying meals to Vande Bharat Trains. Ensuring the working of equipment and proper pest control, and ensuring proper cleaning of the mini pantry and pantry by service provider staff before completion of each round trip. The nature of duty will also require movement in trains (all over India). Ensuring compliance with company policies and standard hospitality procedures/practices. Ensuring proper manpower & materials for nominated mobile/static catering units. Resolving customer/passenger care related issues and effective complaint management. Collecting feedback, its analysis, and course correction. Ensuring statutory compliance/regulations as applicable. Supervising & educating staff in efficient upkeep of equipment and devices. Coordinating with various departments, offices, and business partners. The list is only tentative, and candidates will be assigned duties from time to time as per extant guidelines. Manning the 'Bharat Gaurav Rakes' and supporting all other Tourism related activities. Marketing and back-end support of various tour packages, handling air/rail ticketing of corporate travel and walk-in clients. Ensuring compliance with company policies and standard procedures/practices. Resolving customer/passenger care related issues and effective complaint management. Collecting feedback, its analysis, and course correction. Ensuring statutory compliance/regulations as applicable. Supervising, training & educating staff in efficient services. Coordinating with various departments, Railways, other offices, and business partners.

content_sections.heading: IRCTC SCZ Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for both Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors is through Walk-in Interview, following the same broad process: Candidates must fill in the application form (attached with the respective notification), completing it in all respects. The completed application form must be submitted at the venue of the interview for verification, along with original documents, one set of attested copies of requisite documents, and two recent passport-size photographs. An interview will be conducted, and candidates will be shortlisted based on their credentials and performance in the personal interview. The offer of engagement will be issued to suitable candidates in order of merit and based on the number of vacancies, subject to verification of antecedents. In addition to the shortlisted candidates (22 for Hospitality Monitors, including 4 OBC backlog vacancies; 6 for Tourism Monitors), an equal number of candidates will be placed on a Reserve Panel. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to candidates being found fit in the medical test prescribed for the post. For Hospitality Monitors, candidates will have to undergo a pre-employment medical examination, and continuation in service will also be subject to remaining medically fit. For Tourism Monitors, engagement of selected candidates is subject to being medically fit as prescribed by IRCTC.

faq.question: Q1. What is IRCTC SCZ Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: These are two walk-in interview notifications, both dated 16.09.2026, issued by IRCTC South Central Zone for engagement of Hospitality Monitors (22 posts) and Tourism Monitors (6 posts) on a fixed-term/contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IRCTC SCZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 28 posts are available: 22 Hospitality Monitor posts (including 4 OBC backlog vacancies) and 6 Tourism Monitor posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for IRCTC SCZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Hospitality Monitors interviews are on 05.10.2026 (Bhubaneswar) and 08.10.2026 (Hyderabad). Tourism Monitors interviews are on 06.10.2026 (Bhubaneswar) and 09.10.2026 (Hyderabad), each from 10:30 hrs to 17:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IRCTC Hospitality Monitors?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration, BBA/MBA (Culinary Arts), B.Sc. Hotel Management and Catering Science, or M.B.A (Tourism and Hotel Management) from a recognized institute/university, with age-linked experience requirements (no experience up to 28 years, 1 year for 28–30 years, 2 years for 30–35 years).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IRCTC SCZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Hospitality Monitors, the upper age limit ranges up to 28, 30, or 35 years depending on experience (35 years for UR). For Tourism Monitors, the upper age limit is 35 years for UR. Age relaxation applies for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10 years), and Ex-Servicemen (service rendered plus 3 years).

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for IRCTC Tourism Monitors?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 3-year Bachelor's degree in Tourism (or any stream plus a 1-year Travel & Tourism diploma) with minimum 1 year of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's degree plus a 2-year PG degree/diploma in Travel & Tourism with minimum 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for IRCTC Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors?
faq.answer: Hospitality Monitors receive a CTC of Rs. 30,000/- per month. Tourism Monitors receive a CTC of Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month, based on qualification and experience. Both posts carry additional allowances such as Daily Allowance, Lodging Charges, National Holiday Allowance, and Medical Insurance.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for IRCTC SCZ Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application; eligible candidates must fill the prescribed application proforma and appear directly at the walk-in interview venue on the scheduled date and time, with original documents, attested copies, and photographs.
